bull_case: Fabless 구조에서 R&D와 생태계 투자가 막대한 매출·영업현금흐름으로 전환되고 있다. H1 FY27 OCF $74.4B/FCF $69.9B와 네트워킹·CPU·Rubin 확장은 높은 증분수익률과 장기 재투자 경로를 지지한다.
bear_case: AI buildout이 더 자본집약적으로 변하면서 $279B 공급약정, 고객 인프라 지원, 데이터센터 lease·equity investments가 필요해지고 있다. 성장 유지 자본이 급증하면 과거의 초고 ROIC가 낮아질 수 있다.
thesis: 재투자 효율과 FCF/share 질은 매우 강하지만, 사업모델이 순수 fabless 칩 판매에서 생태계 금융·인프라 약정까지 확장되며 자본집약도가 올라가는 변곡점은 주의해야 한다. 현재 H1 FY27 FCF 규모와 자사주 매입은 희석을 상쇄하고 주당 가치 성장을 지지한다.

evidence.claim: H1 FY27 operating cash flow was $74.421B and NVIDIA-defined free cash flow was $69.895B.
Q2 FY27 segment operating income was $66.595B and H1 segment operating income was $122.871B, while H1 SBC expense was $3.954B.
evidence.value: Segment OI $66.595B Q2 / $122.871B H1; SBC $3.954B H1

evidence.claim: NVIDIA repurchased 203M shares for $39.8B in H1 FY27 and had $99.3B remaining repurchase authorization as of July 26, 2026.
Supply and capacity commitments rose from $119B in the prior quarter to $279B, showing the reinvestment model is becoming more capital-committed.

counterevidence: Commitments and customer support make incremental capital needs much larger than historical fabless optics suggest.
Working-capital needs increased as DSO rose and inventory reached $31.6B.
Some ecosystem investments may produce strategic value without transparent standalone ROIC.
Gross margin can be hit by architecture transitions and export-control inventory charges, as FY26 H20 showed.
unknowns: True incremental ROIC on AI-cloud/infrastructure support commitments
Normalized FCF conversion after Rubin working-capital build
Long-run SBC dilution net of repurchases

uncertainties.rationale: Current returns are exceptional but new infrastructure/partner commitments change the denominator.
Multiple new products and markets support runway, though market saturation timing is uncertain.
Working capital and SBC are manageable today but should be normalized through the cycle.

falsifiers: FCF growth persistently lags revenue while commitments and AR compound faster.
Incremental gross profit from Rubin/AI-cloud expansion fails to earn attractive returns on committed capital.
Diluted share count rises >2% annually despite large repurchases.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current operating-income and FCF growth remain far ahead of balance-sheet operating investment; new commitments warrant monitoring but do not yet show structural ROIC collapse.
H1 SBC is material but NVIDIA repurchased 203M shares for $39.8B; there is no evidence of persistent excessive net dilution at present.

key_kpis.name: FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Grow through cycle after SBC and working-capital normalization

key_kpis.name: Commitments / FCF
key_kpis.threshold: Do not structurally outgrow cash generation

key_kpis.name: Diluted shares
key_kpis.threshold: Flat to declining net share count

subscores.rationale: Current cash generation relative to operating asset base is exceptional.
Rubin, networking, CPU, enterprise and sovereign AI provide several large reinvestment paths.
FCF is enormous and buybacks support per-share value, but working capital and SBC require normalization.
